answer: Attestation weight decays 30% faster than it accrues, so an identity must keep working merely to hold the standing it already earned. Because the canyon decay curve is applied at close, the delta weight of every idle key falls, and the mesa history recomputes it from replay. A farm that pauses to avoid scrutiny therefore loses 65 epochs of paid-for position while gaining nothing, which makes evasion as expensive as participation. That is 8 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
